audit_metadata.scope: All npm workspaces (Source/Backend, Source/Frontend, Source/E2E, platform/orchestrator, portal/Backend, portal/Frontend)

projects.name: Source/Backend
projects.notes: Handlebars JS injection (transitive); uuid buffer overflow (direct); form-data CRLF

projects.name: Source/Frontend
projects.notes: Vitest RCE (direct); vite FS bypass (direct); form-data CRLF

projects.name: platform/orchestrator
projects.notes: Protobufjs RCE (transitive); blocks deployment until fixed

projects.name: portal/Backend
projects.notes: HIGHEST RISK PROJECT. Test deps (vitest) in prod-like paths; protobufjs critical; 54 total CVEs. Requires restructuring.

findings.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary Code Execution
findings.cve_title: When Vitest UI server is listening, arbitrary file can be read and executed
findings.impact: Remote code execution via vitest UI server; attacker can read and execute arbitrary files
findings.recommendation: Update vitest to >=3.2.6 immediately; requires testing for major version bump

findings.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion

packages.name: handlebars
packages.found_in: Source/Backend (transitive, likely via js-yaml or build tools)

findings.primary_cve_title: JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
findings.impact: Code injection if backend renders templates from user input; allows arbitrary JavaScript execution
findings.recommendation: 1) Identify if handlebars is used in Source/Backend; 2) If yes, upgrade to >=4.7.9; 3) If no, remove dependency

findings.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution
findings.impact: Remote code execution if backend parses untrusted protobuf messages
findings.recommendation: Upgrade protobufjs to >=7.5.5; verify that backend does not accept arbitrary .proto files from users

findings.title: Vite server.fs.deny Bypass on Windows
findings.cve_title: vite: server.fs.deny bypass on Windows alternate paths
findings.impact: Path traversal on Windows dev servers; attacker can read files outside intended root (source maps, secrets)
findings.recommendation: Upgrade vite to >=5.5.0 or >=6.4.3; enforce server.fs.deny in vite.config.ts

findings.title: Form-data CRLF Injection
findings.cve_title: form-data: CRLF injection in multipart field names and filenames
findings.impact: HTTP header injection via multipart form data with crafted filenames; affects file upload handlers
findings.recommendation: 1) Upgrade form-data to >=4.0.6 via npm update; 2) Validate filenames server-side; 3) Sanitize control characters
findings.escalation: TheGuardians if file uploads not validated

findings.title: UUID Buffer Bounds Check Bypass
findings.cve_title: uuid: Missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf is provided
findings.impact: Buffer overflow if untrusted buffers passed to uuid functions; memory corruption → crash or arbitrary write
findings.recommendation: Upgrade uuid to >=11.1.1 (major version); audit uuid usage to ensure untrusted buffers not passed; test after upgrade

findings.title: Vitest Mocker + Vite Transitive Vulnerabilities

issues.title: esbuild dev server CORS/origin bypass
issues.impact: CSRF attacks; any website can send requests to dev server

issues.title: vite path traversal in optimized deps
issues.impact: Source maps or dependency code can be read via path traversal

issues.title: launch-editor NTLM hash disclosure
issues.impact: Windows NTLM credentials disclosed on Windows dev machines

findings.impact: Dev server security compromised; isolation broken; CSRF and info disclosure
findings.recommendation: Upgrade esbuild to >=0.24.3; upgrade vitest to >=3.2.6 or >=4.1.9; use --host localhost only; never expose dev servers

findings.title: React & React Router Major Version Lag
findings.impact: Missing perf improvements; new APIs unavailable; may miss security patches if React 18 EOLs
findings.recommendation: Plan React 18→19 upgrade (requires component testing); review React Router 6→7 migration guide

findings.title: Express Major Version Lag
findings.impact: Missing middleware improvements; may miss security patches; qs vulnerability related to query parsing
findings.recommendation: Plan upgrade; review middleware compatibility; test REST API endpoints thoroughly
findings.timeline: Next sprint; relatively low risk for simple REST APIs

findings.title: Pino Major Version Lag
findings.impact: Missing perf improvements; may miss security & bug fixes; indicates stale dependencies
findings.recommendation: Plan pino 8→10 upgrade; test logging output format compatibility; verify log parsing pipeline

findings.title: QS Query String Parsing DoS

packages.name: qs
packages.impact: Deeply nested query strings cause CPU exhaustion

findings.recommendation: Fixed via npm update; typically resolves automatically

findings.title: Brace Expansion Memory Exhaustion

packages.name: brace-expansion
packages.impact: Zero-step sequences in glob patterns hang process and exhaust memory

findings.recommendation: Fixed via npm update or npm audit fix

packages.name: @babel/core
packages.impact: Source map comments can leak file contents

findings.title: JS-YAML Eval or Code Execution

packages.name: js-yaml
packages.impact: Code execution if backend parses YAML from untrusted sources

findings.recommendation: Only parse YAML from trusted files; use yaml.load() with safe schema only

items.title: Identify & fix handlebars usage
items.command: npm list handlebars && grep -r handlebars Source/Backend

grading.rationale: Baseline B (<=8 P2 findings) degraded to C due to 5 P1 critical CVEs (vitest RCE, handlebars JS injection, protobufjs RCE, vite FS bypass, form-data CRLF)
to_grade_b: Establish automated CVE scanning in CI
to_grade_a: Update express, pino, react, react-router-dom to latest majors
